characters.name: Eddard Stark
characters.description: Honourable and just Lord of Winterfell and head of House Stark. He is known for his strict moral code and unwavering loyalty to the law.

characters.name: Catelyn Stark
characters.description: Lady of Winterfell and wife of Eddard Stark, born of House Tully. She is a determined and fiercely protective mother.

characters.name: Robb Stark
characters.description: The eldest son and heir of House Stark, raised to be the future lord of Winterfell. He is known for his leadership abilities and courage.

characters.name: Sansa Stark
characters.description: The eldest daughter of House Stark, raised with chivalric ideals and courtly manners. She dreams of a life at the royal court.

characters.name: Arya Stark
characters.description: The younger daughter of House Stark, wilful and adventurous by nature. She is far more interested in fighting than in conventional feminine roles.

characters.name: Bran Stark
characters.description: The second son of House Stark, a lively boy with a passion for climbing and adventure. He dreams of one day becoming a knight.

characters.name: Jon Snow
characters.description: Raised in Winterfell as a cousin of the Stark children. Honest and dutiful, he joins the Night's Watch at The Wall.

characters.name: Benjen Stark
characters.description: Younger brother of Eddard Stark and First Ranger of the Night's Watch. An experienced ranger who patrols beyond the Wall.

characters.name: Tywin Lannister
characters.description: The mighty head of House Lannister and one of the most feared political strategists in Westeros. He places the honour and power of his house above all else.

characters.name: Cersei Lannister
characters.description: Daughter of Tywin Lannister and Queen of Westeros as wife of King Robert Baratheon. She is ambitious and fiercely protective of her children.

characters.name: Jaime Lannister
characters.description: Member of the Kingsguard and one of the most talented swordsmen in Westeros, nicknamed the 'Kingslayer'. Brother of Cersei and Tyrion.

characters.name: Tyrion Lannister
characters.description: The youngest son of Tywin Lannister, known for his sharp wit, sense of humour, and political cunning. He compensates for his small stature with words and intellect.

characters.name: Joffrey Baratheon
characters.description: Prince of Westeros and heir to the throne, son of Queen Cersei and King Robert. He is spoiled and obsessed with power and prestige.

characters.name: Daenerys Targaryen
characters.description: The last known heir of House Targaryen, once a powerful royal dynasty. She begins her journey as a young woman far from her homeland, finding her way in a hostile world.

characters.name: Viserys Targaryen
characters.description: Older brother of Daenerys and self-proclaimed heir to the Iron Throne. He is determined to reclaim the throne his family lost.

characters.name: Khal Drogo
characters.description: A powerful Dothraki warlord (khal) renowned for his undefeated record in battle. He is the husband of Daenerys Targaryen.

characters.name: Jorah Mormont
characters.description: An exiled Westerosi knight who serves as advisor and protector to Daenerys Targaryen. He has intimate knowledge of Westerosi politics.

characters.name: Robert Baratheon
characters.description: King of the Seven Kingdoms, a once-great warrior who seized the throne in a great rebellion. He now prefers feasting to politics.

characters.name: Stannis Baratheon
characters.description: The middle brother of King Robert Baratheon and Lord of Dragonstone. He is a stern and principled man who believes in duty and justice above all else.

characters.name: Renly Baratheon
characters.description: The youngest brother of King Robert, popular at court and amiable in character. He is Lord of Storm's End.

characters.name: Margaery Tyrell
characters.description: Granddaughter of Olenna Tyrell and a skilled political player at court. She is charming, kind, and popular among the common people.

characters.name: Olenna Tyrell
characters.description: Nicknamed the 'Queen of Thorns', she is the shrewd and sharp-tongued head of House Tyrell. A master of court politics.

characters.name: Loras Tyrell
characters.description: Known as the 'Knight of Flowers', he is one of the most handsome and talented tournament fighters in Westeros.

characters.name: Theon Greyjoy
characters.description: Heir of House Greyjoy and ward raised with House Stark at Winterfell. He struggles with his identity between two worlds.

characters.name: Balon Greyjoy
characters.description: Lord of the Iron Islands and head of House Greyjoy. He is proud of his people's reaving traditions and holds farming and sowing in contempt.

characters.name: Yara Greyjoy
characters.description: Daughter of Balon Greyjoy and captain of her own ship. She is a skilled and courageous fighter who inspires her men.

characters.name: Oberyn Martell
characters.description: Prince of Dorne and nicknamed the 'Red Viper', known for his flamboyance and his deadly skills as a spear fighter and poisoner.

characters.name: Doran Martell
characters.description: Prince of Dorne and the calm, measured head of House Martell. He prefers diplomacy over war.

characters.name: Ellaria Sand
characters.description: Life companion of Oberyn Martell and mother of several of his daughters. She is known for her fierce and fearless character.

characters.name: Lysa Arryn
characters.description: Sister of Catelyn Stark and widow of the former Hand of the King. She rules as regent over the Eyrie on behalf of her young son.

characters.name: Robin Arryn
characters.description: Young Lord of the Eyrie and heir of House Arryn. He grows up in the impregnable castle high in the mountains.

houses.name: The Night's Watch
houses.motto: Night gathers, and now my watch begins

characters.name: Jeor Mormont
characters.description: Lord Commander of the Night's Watch, nicknamed the 'Old Bear'. He leads the brotherhood with a strict but just hand.

characters.name: Samwell Tarly
characters.description: A kind and well-read young man who enlists in the Night's Watch. He is no born fighter but possesses a sharp mind and broad knowledge.

characters.name: Petyr Baelish
characters.description: Nicknamed 'Littlefinger', he is the Master of Coin at the court of King's Landing. A master of intrigue and financial manipulation.

characters.name: Varys
characters.description: The Master of Whisperers at the court of King's Landing, nicknamed the 'Spider'. He commands a vast network of informants throughout Westeros.
